concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-onboard-users-terms-of-service]] — 2026-09-15 Business Accounts onboarding ToS flow for webhook requirement, test/live document types, generated document IDs, authorized individual signer and acceptance-record readback.
warnings: The guide says test returns only adyenForPlatformsAdvanced, despite a nearby illustrative response listing three types; do not treat that sample as the test rule.
Generated document type/ID and versioned LEM v3/SDK test examples do not establish a fixed current Terms-of-Service version or actual user consent.
A Terms acceptance record must be matched to the correct main entity, document and individual signer; setup alone does not prove account opening or financial operation.
